writtenCells.value: Between the battery and the converter
Orange cable with shielding, cut area 35 mm

The battery pack is connected to the chassis by welded steel residency. Each resident is checked in the calculation and experiment. Between the cells and the chassis walls there is a continuous insulation layer. The cables pass through closed channels and do not touch sharp parts. Above the cells an insulating panel is installed that prevents accidental contact. The lid is closed in bolts and does not open without a working tool. The driver cannot touch any part of the propulsion system. All the exposed conductive parts are illuminated to the chassis.
